_meta.about: Measured baselines of the grey-CR Phase A tests (cr_baselines.py; Phase A plan X1/X2). Gates: errors <= 1.5x, orders >= value - margin, physical quantities two-sided.
_meta.measured: 2026-10-12, GPU (RTX 2080 Ti), branch feature/cosmic-rays-grey at 1008ccb plus the uncommitted ETD2RK / A4 / X1-X2 changes; entries dated 2026-10-13 re-measured after the van Leer CR rows (e230c25) and the HLLC + hybrid CR entropy default (uncommitted)
_meta.refresh: CR_UPDATE_BASELINES=1 python <test file>  (records instead of comparing; review the diff)
_meta.scheme: ETD2RK F_cr relaxation (default), stage-wise CR coupling, MINMOD gas / van Leer CR rows; Riemann solver RIEMANN_SOLVER_AUTO (HLLC + total-pressure flux for unsplit FV Cartesian grey-CR runs, HLL otherwise) and cr_entropy auto (hybrid, SHOCKS transfer) unless the test sets them explicitly
